See docs/decisions/2026-09-27-qualify-dedicated-worker-mode.md and, for protocol version 2, docs/decisions/2026-09-27-decide-pii-retention-and-activation-ownership.md section 3.

See docs/decisions/2026-09-27-qualify-dedicated-worker-mode.md and, for protocol version 2, docs/decisions/2026-09-27-decide-pii-retention-and-activation-ownership.md section 3.
